metaTitle: Custom Embroidery Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery lanyards and badges with your logo. Durable, professional, and perfect for bulk orders. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Embroidery on lanyards and badge reels provides a textured, long-lasting logo that won't peel or fade like printed alternatives. This decoration method is ideal for corporate uniforms, trade shows, and annual events where a premium, sewn-in look conveys durability and attention to detail. Choose from polyester or nylon webbing in various widths, and pair your embroidered lanyard with a matching badge holder for a cohesive, professional set that withstands daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery lanyards and badges with sewn logos for corporate events and trade shows
